POSTGRES_USER.name: POSTGRES_USER
POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Change to harden the default account.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Master database password — auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by all Supabase services (auth, rest, realtime, storage) via ${{postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

POSTGRES_DB.name: POSTGRES_DB
POSTGRES_DB.description: Name of the default database created on first boot. All Supabase schemas (auth, storage, _realtime, public) are created inside this database.

POSTGRES_PORT.name: POSTGRES_PORT
POSTGRES_PORT.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432 — all other services reference this port via private networking.

PGDATA.name: PGDATA
PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory, placed under the Railway persistent volume mount (/var/lib/postgresql/data). Changing this after first boot will orphan existing data.

DATABASE_URL.name: DATABASE_URL
DATABASE_URL.description: Self-referencing connection string. Consumed by the postgres service itself and referenced by dependent services as ${{postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.
